description:
Phase E of the Results Explorer strategy revision
(plans/purring-jingling-petal-ultraplan).

The master leaderboard (Phase B) and the query workbench (Phase C)
both want shareable URLs that round-trip filter state. Existing
BenchmarkIndex/PlatformIndex filter selects use local `useState`,
which makes cohort/SF/phase choices invisible to navigation and
bookmarks.

Introduce a tiny `useUrlState<T>(key, initial, serde)` hook using
`history.replaceState` + `popstate`. Migrate existing filter
`useState` call sites directly - no API surface invention, just a
swap.

anti_patterns.dont: centralise all filter state into a context

anti_patterns.why: filter changes should not spam browser history

preserves.behavior: Existing BenchmarkIndex/PlatformIndex filter behavior is identical - URL sync is additive
No new dependencies - hook uses only built-in history/popstate APIs
vite-ssg build continues to succeed (hook must be SSR-safe)

verifications.command: cd results-explorer && npm run typecheck && npm test
verifications.description: Explorer typecheck + Vitest suites green (including useUrlState tests)
URL round-trips on BenchmarkIndex and PlatformIndex
verifications.expected: changing SF/phase/tuning updates URL; reload restores state; back button works

work_units.notes:
New file: results-explorer/src/lib/useUrlState.ts
  - Read initial value from URL (?key=...) via the provided
    serde.decode; fall back to `initial` if absent/invalid
  - setValue updates state and calls
    history.replaceState(null, "", newSearch) - no history spam
  - Subscribe to `popstate` so back/forward re-hydrate state
  - Provide a default serde for string; optionals:
    arraySerde (comma-separated), numberSerde, jsonSerde
Must be SSR-safe no-op (check typeof window) since vite-ssg
is used for build.

Direct swap: each `const [foo, setFoo] = useState(...)` that
drives a filter select becomes useUrlState with an appropriate
key (e.g., sf, phase, tuning). No behavior change beyond URL
round-trip.
work_units.summary: Migrate BenchmarkIndex filter selects to useUrlState
Migrate PlatformIndex filter selects to useUrlState

work_units.notes:
tests in src/lib/__tests__/useUrlState.test.ts covering:
  - initial value from URL beats `initial`
  - invalid URL value falls back to `initial`
  - setValue writes ?key=... without pushing history
  - popstate re-hydrates (simulate via

  - SSR no-op when window is undefined
